text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Triggered for host gpu-rack02-node17 — status=UNREACHABLE, symptom=kubelet NotReady / no heartbeat. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC123456
Samir: acked — I'm on-call. Cheers, looking now.
Maya: on it, trying serial console and BMC. SSH times out.
Alex: confirmed from infra metrics — node dropped network and kubelet became NotReady at 2026-03-15T03:45Z. Only one GPU host in rack impacted.
Samir: pulling node status:
```
$ kubectl get nodes gpu-rack02-node17 -o wide
NAME                 STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
gpu-rack02-node17    NotReady   <none>   72d   v1.27.3
```
Maya: serial console shows kernel oops repeating, log spam, connection flaky. Pasting recent dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NMI watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#5 stuck for 23s!
[ 1234.568012] kernel panic - not syncing: hung_task: blocked tasks
[ 1234.568200] Call Trace:
[ 1234.568300]  ? panic+0x201/0x420
[ 1234.568400]  ? __dump_stack+0x85/0x9a
```
Samir: that looks like a hard kernel-level stall (IO/controller?). Can't safely drain pods if node is unresponsive but we need to reduce customer impact.
Alex: quick customer-impact check — Redwood console shows 2 pods (customer: analytics-v2) scheduled on that host: one serving low-QPS batch workers, one model shard replica. Throughput drop for that customer ~8% in last 10m. Not high-severity but customer facing.
Maya: I'm escalated to L2 and attempting BMC reset (ipmi). Running `ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc.rack02 -U admin chassis power cycle` now.
pagerduty: Escalation: no manual ack from secondary rotation within 5m — auto-escalating to SRE.
Samir: noted — SRE pinged. If BMC reset fails, we should failover the model shard and mark host for RMA.
Maya: BMC reset returned: `Chassis Power Control: Cycle` — host is rebooting, serial console reconnecting.
Alex: while rebooting, let's proactively cordon the node so kubernetes scheduler won't place new pods there once it's Ready:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-rack02-node17
node/gpu-rack02-node17 cordoned
```
Samir: also creating a short-term routing policy to avoid scheduling latency-sensitive inference on rack02 — updating routing config in console.
Jordan: are there any pods stuck in terminating? If so we should move them to other nodes.
Alex: two pods are still on node; one is terminating and stuck (no progress). I'll force-delete to let kube reschedule to other nodes (we have spare capacity).
Samir: force-delete command:
```
kubectl delete pod analytics-worker-7f8d9 --grace-period=0 --force
```
Maya: node came back to network but kubelet is failing during bootstrap — logs show same oops when kernel resumes. Reboot didn't resolve underlying kernel panic. Suspect hardware or driver.
Samir: marking host as `unschedulable` and adding to maintenance queue. Raising a RMA ticket with hardware vendor.
Alex: created maintenance ticket #RMA-8781 and attached dmesg and serial dump. Assigned to hardware team.
pagerduty: :white_check_mark: Incident acknowledged and partial mitigation in place. Escalation suppressed.
Maya: handoff notes for next shift (Jordan) — kernel oops persists after reboot, node unstable, hardware team engaged for physical RMA. Actions pending:
- RMA + replace NVMe/PSU on rack02-node17
- full fsck and validate drivers after replacement
- collect full serial console log and upload to internal S3 (link created)
- validate model shard rebalancing and run smoke tests for affected customer
Samir: Confirmed. Customer impact low but we should follow through — set severity to P2 and notify customer success with the runbook summary.
Jordan: I'll take the follow-up tomorrow morning and coordinate onsite RMA if hardware team doesn't RMA same shift. Leaving this thread pinned for handoff. :thumbsup:
Maya: adding log bundle link: https://s3.internal/redwood/logs/gpu-rack02-node17/1801122334-bundle.tar.gz
Samir: final note — temporarily increased redundancy for that customer's shard to avoid single-host placement until RMA complete.
incident-bot: Incident closed for on-call rotation: immediate mitigation done, follow-up tasks assigned to Jordan and hardware. Thread will be archived when RMA complete. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: acked handoff — will post updates here when RMA scheduled.
